verdict.rationale: LlamaParse exposes a programmatic API/SDK plus webhooks so jobs can be automated at scale, and Classify lets rules be saved and referenced across multiple jobs, suggesting some bulk workflow support. However there is no explicit documentation of a batch/bulk submission endpoint, multi-file job queue, or bulk status/management UI for large sets of items. Missing for 10: explicit batch-submit API, bulk job dashboard/management, and independent evidence of large-scale bulk usage in production.
